differences: The paper's 37 non-response trials cannot be counted: the shared table holds answered trials only (13,059, 8 fewer than the 13,104 planned minus 37), and one participant's block labels give 4 blocks instead of 6, so the paper's 234 blocks are not reproduced by counting labels.

The mixed-effects JNDs in JND_Choices.mat give reference 50.469 +- 3.061 mm/s (paper 50.478 +- 3.057) and testing slow 38.149 +- 4.577; comfortable 52.904 +- 4.333; fast 76.903 +- 8.773 mm/s (paper slow 37.941 +- 4.657, comfortable 53.594 +- 4.346, fast 77.588 +- 8.760), and paired t-test p-values slow 0.0109, comfortable 0.9495, fast 0.0001 (paper 0.010, 0.385, < 0.001): close to the paper except the comfortable test, so the deposited estimates seem to come from a slightly different fit than the one reported; the paper's own mixed-model fit is not re-run here.
